paragraphs.text: Cards from Ixalan compared to cards from earlier sets .
Bishop's Soldier is strictly better than Ajani's Sunstriker and Boros Mastiff .
Blight Keeper is strictly better than Nightshade Stinger .
Charging Monstrosaur is strictly better than Gerrard's Irregulars , Night Revelers , and Thundering Giant .
Costly Plunder is strictly better than Altar's Reap .

Deeproot Warrior is strictly better than Cave Tiger , Norwood Warrior , Trained Cheetah , and vanilla bears ( Balduvian Bears , Barbary Apes , Bear Cub , Cylian Elf , Forest Bear , Grizzly Bears , Runeclaw Bear , and Treetop Warden ).
Dinosaur Stampede is strictly better than Trumpet Blast .
Dive Down is strictly better than Glint .
Duskborne Skymarcher is strictly better than Aven Skirmisher and Eager Cadet .
Encampment Keeper is strictly better than Tundra Wolves .
Kitesail Freebooter is strictly better than Bog Imp .
Lookout's Dispersal is strictly better than Convolute .
March of the Drowned is strictly better than Raise Dead .
One With The Wind is strictly better than Jeskai Runemark .
Ritual of Rejuvenation is strictly better than Reviving Dose .
Savage Stomp is strictly better than Hunt the Weak .
Siren Stormtamer is strictly better than Flying Men .
Skittering Heartstopper is strictly better than Hunted Ghoul .
Vicious Conquistador is strictly better than Thornbow Archer and Pulse Tracker .
Bishop of the Bloodstained is strictly worse than Malakir Bloodwitch .
Dark Inquiry is strictly worse than Doomfall and Pick the Brain .
Glorifier of Dusk is strictly worse than Serra Angel .
Grazing Whiptail is strictly worse than Seed Guardian .
Legion's Judgment is strictly worse than Reprisal and Skywhaler's Shot .
Unclaimed Territory is strictly worse than Cavern of Souls .
Unfriendly Fire is strictly worse than Lightning Blast .
Headwater Sentries is a color-shifted Dutiful Servants from Hour of Devastation (white to blue).
Frenzied Raptor is a color-shifted Alpine Grizzly from Khans of Tarkir (green to red).
